method: Nearest polygon edge by local tangent projection; 300m screening buffer around a 250m app rule. Not a surveyed boundary, exact geodesic verdict, legal jurisdiction or public-access validation.
limitations: Topology checks use the full fixed OSM source geometry, including seas, holes and external small faces. They do not establish formal administrative or legal jurisdiction.
The 250 m rule is a candidate distance check, not a safe route or public-access proof. Macau A-Ma Temple is about 205.7 m from the source boundary and remains an ordinary non-unlocking point.
All physical photo positions, GPS performance, opening hours, ferry availability and accessible routes still require current local or field validation.
Displayed area is the complete source display area, including water and external faces; it is not official land area.
Macau latitude bands 22.173 and 22.13 are editorial game masks, not parish boundaries, and do not include all Hengqin.
